messages:
mika: Idea: run a 10-partner 'micro-beta' focused on onboarding friction for private deployments. Objectives: shorten time-to-first-call, validate the self-serve HSM/KMS steps, and capture 3 reproducible perf failure cases. Thoughts?
omar: Strong yes. Recommend partners split: 4 private infra, 3 dedicated, 3 hosted->private migration. That gives cross-surface signal.
trina: For recruitment, limit to partners who've opened a support ticket in last 90 days (signal intent) OR existing Dedicated customers interested in feature parity. Also include 2 startups for fast feedback.
ben: Success metrics (binary + numeric): 1) Onboarding_complete_within_48h (Y/N), 2) First_API_call_time_minutes, 3) Number_of_blocker_tickets, 4) Qual_score (1-10) from post-pilot survey.
mika: Operational constraints: Eng oncall coverage, dedicated CS rep per partner, legal consent for data capture. If any missing we delay.
cs-bot: bot: Created cohort tag `dp-mini-may2026`. Use tag in invites.
omar: Proposed protocol for feedback: 1) Partner runs three canonical tasks (pin model + canary, KMS roundtrip, prefix-cache warmup), 2) If fail -> capture minimal repro + logs + local perf trace, 3) Triage into triage board with severity.
trina: We should include a short eval harness repo snippet partners can clone: a small script that runs three tasks and POSTs results to our intake webhook. Make it <5 steps.
ben: Survey (post-run): Q1: How clear was the onboarding? (1-5), Q2: Did you hit blockers? (Y/No), Q3: Would require our Dedicated/Private for prod? (Y/N). Also optional: short free text for pain points.
mika: Compensation: $100 credit applied to account after checklist + survey. Legal to approve consent text: "We may collect anonymized logs and performance metrics to improve product. You can opt out of logs but still participate."
omar: Timeline suggestion: Recruit window May 10-17, onboarding May 18-24, active testing May 24-Jun 7 (14 days), report Jun 14. Need signoffs by May 6.
trina: Outreach cadence: Day 0 invite, Day 2 setup reminder, Day 6 CS check-in, Day 10 survey nudge. Use outreach-runner sequence `dp-mini-may2026`.
cs-bot: bot: Outreach sequence `dp-mini-may2026` created. Command: `/outreach start dp-mini-may2026 --cohort=dp-mini-may2026`
ben: Triage SLAs: acknowledge within 24h, assign within 48h, fix-or-mitigation plan within 10 business days for severity P0/P1.
mika: Acceptance gate to 'graduate' partner: 1) completed checklist, 2) no P0 unresolved, 3) qual_score >=6 or explicit upgrade intent. Graduates get fastlane for Dedicated trials.
omar: Data/measurement: dashboard filters: cohort tag, onboarding_time_mins, checklist_pct, tokens_14d, qual_nps. We'll compare against baseline dp cohorts.
trina: Action items: Mika - draft invite & checklist; Omar - eval harness and triage board; Ben - survey + success gate templates; CS-bot - create cohort and outreach (done). Reconvene Fri to lock copy.
mika: I'll drop draft invite by Tue. If no objections I'll lock schedule and start legal ping.
